symptom: ako/mxcli#981 items 4-5: `r.Name + ' x' as S` declared `string` or `string(100)` passes check, CE6770 in mxbuild (String(200) builds); a view attribute declared `autonumber` over an AutoNumber column passes check, CE6770
cause: inferTypeStatic had no rule for `+` (fell through to Unknown); typesCompatible accepted declared AutoNumber on purpose, pending a language header (ADR-0011)
insight: Concatenation is a derived string: String(200) whatever the operand lengths. A new rejection that check previously accepted goes behind a langver.Change (MDL-V1-VIEWAUTONUMBER) — and check's reference tier ran with langVersion 0 regardless of the header, so ValidateProgram(WithWarnings) now enters the program's language version
